title: The end of Yu Yangzi
summary: The righteous disciples beat the Longevity Hall at the swamp's edge; Lu Xueqi calls down divine thunder with her sword, and the Longevity Hall flees vowing revenge. Yu Yangzi, weakened after using a Blood Curse to break out, resolves to enter the swamp for the treasure, but that night Qin Wuyan and Jin Ping'er corner him. Jin Ping'er reveals that Yu Yangzi killed her disciple and blamed the Ten Thousand Poisons Sect to set them against each other. Gui Li arrives as well; Yu Yangzi's men surrender, and Yu Yangzi offers to join Gui Li, who refuses, and the old master dies. In the Qingyun camp Wen Min teases Song Daren for being naive, and Xiao Yicai sends a few strong disciples into the poisonous inner swamp. Gui Li leaves Ye Gou Daoren and Sha Sheng to watch the swamp's edge and learns that Qing Long and Zhu Que have secretly come to the Dead Swamp. Xiao Huan returns Gui Li's umbrella, and the disciples enter the poison fog.
